bbd43a61a7714ddb.what: Fine-tuned the MACE-MPA-0 foundation model with custom C–N–Cu data and combined non-equilibrium MD with MLIP-driven lattice dynamics to study how N-termination changes Cu/diamond interfacial thermal conductance (ITC).
bbd43a61a7714ddb.why: Poor Cu/diamond ITC limits Cu–diamond composites for electronic cooling, and metallic coatings cause graphitization.
bbd43a61a7714ddb.how: MACE fine-tuning, NEMD plus lattice dynamics, mode-resolved phonon spectroscopy, LDOS overlap and COHP analysis. Anharmonic effects contribute ~60% of ITC; N-termination raises ITC by 10%, and ~80% of that gain comes from harmonic transmission.
bbd43a61a7714ddb.impact: Highly relevant to the GaN/Al₂O₃ interface and BAs interface work and to the MLPhonon workflow: it is a template for fine-tuning MACE and combining NEMD with lattice-dynamics ITC decomposition (harmonic vs anharmonic, mode-resolved).

742f670783484f97.what: Measured temperature-dependent DC characteristics of N-polar GaN/AlGaN/AlN HEMTs from room temperature to 800 °C.
742f670783484f97.why: GaN HEMTs need stable operation at high temperature and higher breakdown voltage; AlN has about twice the GaN bandgap and better thermal conductivity as a buffer.
742f670783484f97.how: Experimental device characterization; the N-polar structure showed stable DC characteristics up to 600 °C, better than the conventional AlGaN/GaN HEMT.
742f670783484f97.impact: Moderate relevance to the GaN/AlGaN HEMT multiscale thermal modeling project: it gives an experimental device structure (AlN buffer) and high-temperature data that could motivate or benchmark self-heating simulations. No thermal-transport modeling is stated in the abstract.

bb0aa89da8a1143e.what: Proposes BSE@qKI, which replaces GW quasiparticle energies with Koopmans-compliant spectral functionals in the Bethe-Salpeter equation, implemented as an automated AiiDA workflow.
bb0aa89da8a1143e.why: GW calculations for first-principles exciton characterization are computationally demanding.
bb0aa89da8a1143e.how: AiiDA workflow benchmarked on semiconductors; mean absolute relative errors are 13% for band gaps and 4% for first exciton energies. Also applied to CrI3.
bb0aa89da8a1143e.impact: Low relevance: it concerns excitons and optical spectra, not phonon transport. Only the automated, reproducible workflow design is loosely transferable to lattice-dynamics workflows.

384ad5c3d876cfa1.what: Studies tetragonal Cu2CdSiTe4 thermoelectrics using first-principles calculations, MLIPs and Boltzmann transport with a two-channel (phonon + diffuson) model; reports κl of 0.76 W m–1 K–1 at 700 K and ZT of 1.75 at 700 K.
384ad5c3d876cfa1.why: Cu2ABX4 chalcogenides have inherently low lattice thermal conductivity, which makes them promising for thermoelectrics.
384ad5c3d876cfa1.how: DFT, MLIPs, Boltzmann transport theory and a phonon two-channel model; strong acoustic–optical coupling and anharmonicity give flattened dispersions and strong scattering.
384ad5c3d876cfa1.impact: Low-to-moderate relevance: the MLIP + BTE + two-channel workflow resembles the MLPhonon pipeline and could inform handling of strongly anharmonic, low-κ materials, but the material is not among the current projects.

3bbab0330715b5f8.what: Shows that PBE-based MLIPs, including NequIP-OAM-L and MatterSim-v1-5M foundation models, wrongly predict an I41/amd structure of HfO2 as more stable than the experimental P21/c ground state.
3bbab0330715b5f8.why: MLIPs trained on PBE data inherit functional errors, which affect the reliability of structure and phase-transition simulations.
3bbab0330715b5f8.how: Compared DFT functionals: PBE over-stabilizes low-density sixfold Hf–O octahedral phases, while PBEsol and LDA largely remove the error. The error also affects ferroelectric switching barriers.
3bbab0330715b5f8.impact: Useful for the MLIP failure-modes interest: a caution for MACE and Deep Potential models trained on PBE data in the InGaAs, BAs, GaN and BaTiO₃/SrTiO₃ (oxide) projects. Check the functional choice, especially for oxides and lattice-relaxation-sensitive properties.

da9ff5b81dd5e2cc.what: Measured the effective thermal conductivity of Cu/dielectric hybrid bonding layers in 3D-ICs with TDTR combined with picosecond ultrasonics and shallow-angle polishing.
da9ff5b81dd5e2cc.why: Heat transport in hybrid bonding structures must be understood for thermal design of 3D-ICs.
da9ff5b81dd5e2cc.how: Depth-resolved TDTR plus acoustic echoes to locate buried interfaces and thickness. Thermal conductivity is 1.14–1.75 W m-1K-1 for the bottom pad layer and 1.76–4.34 W m-1K-1 for the top pad layer; it depends on Cu area fraction and increases with remaining thickness.
da9ff5b81dd5e2cc.impact: Moderate relevance to electronics thermal-management industry trends: it provides experimental effective-κ and boundary-resistance data for 3D-IC packaging that device-scale thermal simulations (e.g., JAX-BTE, interface models) could use as input or benchmarks.

a4b404eefce7b0c2.what: Combines medium-entropy alloying (Sb, Pb, Ge, Mn) with Ce doping in SnTe to reach a peak ZT of ~1.3 at 723 K and an average ZT of ~0.92 (323–823 K).
a4b404eefce7b0c2.why: Electrical and thermal transport parameters are coupled, which limits thermoelectric performance.
a4b404eefce7b0c2.how: Experimental alloying: medium-entropy design converges valence bands and adds lattice strain, and Ce acts as a donor and forms nanoprecipitates that scatter phonons.
a4b404eefce7b0c2.impact: Low relevance: an experimental thermoelectric alloy study with no overlap with the listed projects beyond general phonon scattering.

708d9a50517e5382.what: Presents VQkit, a Python toolkit for pre- and post-processing DFT calculations in VASP and Quantum ESPRESSO, with cross-code structure conversion and input generation.
708d9a50517e5382.why: Fragmented pre- and post-processing across DFT codes makes workflows inconsistent.
708d9a50517e5382.how: Unified structure representation; benchmarked on elastic properties of HfC, ZrC, ZrO2, Ti and diamond, agreeing closely with VASPKIT for VASP, with differences in the QE results.
708d9a50517e5382.impact: Possibly useful: you use VASP, so it could streamline structure and input handling for the lattice-dynamics and MLIP training-data pipelines. Not a phonon-specific tool; it is worth a quick look rather than an adoption decision.

ffb8f81dbf6c3226.what: Group-theoretic analysis of why some tensor-product paths in equivariant MLIPs such as NequIP carry no signal (Aggregation Cancellation), plus path pruning tests.
ffb8f81dbf6c3226.why: Local site symmetry can make symmetry-allowed paths vanish after neighbor aggregation, which suggests redundancy in equivariant models.
ffb8f81dbf6c3226.how: Probes on TiO₆, CaTiO₃ and six OMat24 models; pruning 60% of 174 paths changed force MAE by 1.42%, 0.04% and 1.83% on CaTiO₃, OMat24 Oₕ-cubic and low-symmetry data. Speedups are structural proxies only, not measured.
ffb8f81dbf6c3226.impact: Relevant to the MLIP interpretability and efficiency interest: the symmetry-based analysis of equivariant models (MACE-like) could inform path pruning for faster MLIPs in the perovskite oxide (BaTiO₃, SrTiO₃) work. Transfer to other architectures is stated as open.

c9ed0c91d6b012f1.what: A Physical Review X paper on electron-phonon coupling across the TMD/hBN van der Waals interface. Not stated in the abstract (no abstract provided).
c9ed0c91d6b012f1.impact: Low relevance based on the title alone: electron-phonon coupling at a vdW interface is only loosely related to interfacial phonon thermal transport in the current projects.

031816f3b50417ae.what: Fabricated tungsten-coated CVD diamond by CMSII and PLD, and measured thermal properties with transient grating spectroscopy and ns-TDTR.
031816f3b50417ae.why: Aims at a plasma-facing material for fusion reactors; PLD gave better adhesion and fracture resistance than CMSII.
031816f3b50417ae.how: PLD gave a crack-free microscale polycrystalline W layer on diamond with thermal diffusivity comparable to rolled tungsten.
031816f3b50417ae.impact: Low relevance: a fusion-materials experiment. The diamond interface and TDTR measurement overlap only slightly with interfacial thermal transport interests. Flagged because the author Martin Kuball is on the watch list.

28fc180da3861566.what: EPC Space added plastic QFN (PQFN) and hermetic packaging options to its radiation-tolerant GaN HEMT portfolio.
28fc180da3861566.why: Next-generation space power systems need radiation-hardened power management in harsh environments.
28fc180da3861566.how: Product announcement: rad-hard enhancement-mode GaN-on-silicon devices with new packaging options. Not stated: thermal performance.
28fc180da3861566.impact: Low-to-moderate relevance: an industry signal for GaN HEMT commercialization and packaging, which is relevant to the HEMT self-heating project and to industry job awareness. No thermal data given.

3f2071bfb3724339.what: Semiconductor Engineering blog roundup covering PCIe security, co-design of silicon, memory, cooling and power for AI racks, 3D-IC and chiplet design, AI data centers, and memory pressure from AI agents.
3f2071bfb3724339.why: Shows how AI workloads are driving system-level co-design.
3f2071bfb3724339.how: Link roundup of vendor blogs (Cadence, Synopsys, Siemens, Keysight, Arm, Rambus and others). Not stated: technical details.
3f2071bfb3724339.impact: Low relevance; of some interest for industry trends, especially the Siemens piece on 3D-IC/chiplet complexity and the Synopsys piece on cooling in co-design, which relate to thermal-management job markets.

7bc19d081ffb5088.what: JAX v0.12.1 release: Pallas APIs under jax.pallas, a with_logs option for grad, jax.avals, fma/fmuladd, new DotAlgorithmPreset options and CPU float16 support.
7bc19d081ffb5088.why: Routine release adding features and fixes.
7bc19d081ffb5088.how: Release notes on GitHub; the abstract is truncated.
7bc19d081ffb5088.impact: Relevant to the JAX-BTE and GPU phonon BTE solver work: the Pallas kernel API and fused multiply-add / matmul precision options could matter for custom GPU kernels. Check for breaking changes before upgrading.

e6c4426ce09cd834.what: GitHub repo for Phonon fine-tuning (PFT, ICML'26) and Nequix, a materials foundation model trained on a budget (NeurIPS'25 AI4Mat).
e6c4426ce09cd834.why: Not stated beyond the topic tags: interatomic potentials, machine learning, materials science.
e6c4426ce09cd834.how: Python code release; details are not stated in the provided text.
e6c4426ce09cd834.impact: Highly relevant: phonon fine-tuning of MLIPs directly targets accuracy of phonon properties, which matches the MLPhonon, InGaAs (DP vs MACE) and AlGaN MLIP pipelines. Worth reading the code and paper.

b489b91b77ab04a0.what: Semiconductor Engineering panel excerpts on whether AI agents can shift chip design flow left, covering orchestration across tools, siloed proprietary data and cost.
b489b91b77ab04a0.why: Agents are entering design, verification and validation, but connecting them across tools is unsolved.
b489b91b77ab04a0.how: Panel discussion with Synopsys, Hiveware, Silvaco and Axiomise.
b489b91b77ab04a0.impact: Low-to-moderate relevance: shows industry thinking on agent orchestration and automated workflows, which parallels agents for first-principles and thermal-MD calculations. It is about chip design, not materials simulation.

f0011f21edee50d2.what: PyFock: a pure-Python DFT and electronic structure code with GPU acceleration via just-in-time compilation.
f0011f21edee50d2.why: Aims for an efficient, fully parallelized DFT code in Python.
f0011f21edee50d2.how: Gaussian-basis DFT and Hartree-Fock with CUDA support through JIT compilation.
f0011f21edee50d2.impact: Low relevance: a Gaussian-basis molecular code, not a periodic plane-wave solver like VASP. Of mild interest for GPU-JIT design ideas relevant to JAX-based solvers.

d9a364db626c8810.what: BioSimSpace: an interoperable Python framework for biomolecular simulation.
d9a364db626c8810.why: Aims at interoperability and reproducibility in molecular simulation and free-energy calculations.
d9a364db626c8810.how: Python framework; details are not stated beyond the topic tags.
d9a364db626c8810.impact: Low relevance: focused on biomolecular and drug-discovery simulation.

6c081a41915be9af.what: IEEE IRPS website updated: IRPS 2027 is Mar. 21–25, 2027 in San Diego, CA, with a call for papers; the topic list includes thermal reliability of GaN/SiC devices.
6c081a41915be9af.why: IRPS is the premier microelectronics reliability conference.
6c081a41915be9af.how: No deadline sentences were found on the page; the submission format and deadlines are not stated.
6c081a41915be9af.impact: Possibly worth submitting: GaN HEMT self-heating and thermal reliability work would fit. US-held. Check the call for papers for the abstract deadline before deciding.
